channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Detroit Lions’ New OC Makes One Free Agent Tight End an Obvious Fit
item.description: With Drew Petzing bringing a 13-personnel offense to Detroit, the Lions should strongly consider signing free agent tight end David Njoku as the perfect complement and insurance for Sam LaPorta.

item.title: Are You Mad At Amon-Ra St. Brown For Firing Back At Detroit Lions Fans Over Drew Petzing Hire?
item.description: Amon-Ra St. Brown fires back at Detroit Lions fans criticizing the Drew Petzing hire and urges everyone to trust Dan Campbell and the front office.

item.title: Aidan Hutchinson Named Defensive Player of the Year Finalist After Remarkable Comeback Season
item.description: Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson is a finalist for NFL Defensive Player of the Year after recording 14.5 sacks in 2025, just one season removed from breaking his leg in 2024.

item.title: Barry Sanders Runs Blazing 40-Yard Dash While Wearing Sweats
item.description: NFL analyst Gil Brandt recalls Barry Sanders stepping off a plane, putting on sweats, and running a stunning 4.37-second 40-yard dash at his Oklahoma State Pro Day before the 1989 NFL Draft.

item.title: Ex-Michigan Receiver Makes Explosive Claim About Sherrone Moore
item.description: Former Michigan wide receiver Anthony Simpson alleges that Sherrone Moore was “blackmailed” by players and staff during the scandal that led to Moore’s firing, claiming it affected playing time decisions.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Sign OF Corey Julks
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have signed outfielder Corey Julks to a minor league contract with an invitation to spring training, giving him a chance to compete for a reserve role in 2026.

item.title: Detroit Lions T Dan Skipper Announces Decision for 2026
item.description: Detroit Lions offensive tackle Dan Skipper has announced his retirement after 24 years in football and will transition into a coaching career ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: Dan Skipper Already Taking First Steps Toward Coaching Career After Retirement
item.description: Former Detroit Lions offensive tackle Dan Skipper is already taking his first steps into coaching, volunteering as an offensive line coach at the East-West Shrine Bowl after announcing his retirement.

item.title: Here’s When Detroit Lions’ New OC Drew Petzing Is Expected to Speak Publicly
item.description: The Detroit Lions are expected to hire Drew Petzing as their new offensive coordinator, but when will he speak publicly for the first time? All signs point to the NFL Scouting Combine in late February.

item.title: Detroit Lions Release Hilarious Dan Skipper Tribute Video
item.description: The Detroit Lions released a hilarious and emotional tribute video for Dan Skipper after his retirement, featuring “Reporting as Eligible,” a TD catch, a game ball from Dan Campbell, hydrangeas, and a near puke moment.
